facts.fact: POTRAZ Regulatory Notice 2 of 2026, signed by its director-general, announces mandatory compliance inspections and assessments of data controllers from 1 September 2026, risk-based and starting with financial, insurance, local authority, health and mining sectors; no sanction is reported. Notice date not given, so the published date is used.
POTRAZ states it is the designated Data Protection Authority under section 5 of the Act and is acting as such, having trained data protection officers and engaged organisations for over two years.

note: carried from dataprotectionauthority, dataprotectionlaw; no document opened
